basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old art student based in Seattle, WA, who recently discovered the world of manga and anime. My journey began with Beastars, and I've been hooked ever since. I have a knack for sketching, and I'm often found doodling characters from my favorite series. When I'm not diving into the latest anime episodes, you can find me exploring local art galleries or trying out new coffee shops. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends catching up with friends online. My typical online hours are in the evenings, after school assignments are done. Currently, I'm working part-time at a local bookstore, which allows me to keep up with the latest graphic novels and manga.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As an art student, I have a foundational understanding of visual arts, which I am constantly expanding through my studies and personal projects. My interest in manga has led me to explore its artistic techniques, and I often spend time analyzing different styles to improve my own sketches.
